comment: What reads each object a CPE exposes. The parity gate takes every leaf of a device's walked model, finds the first entry whose `paths` match it (regular expressions over the path with instance numbers written {i}), and asks whether anything reads it. `platform: false` marks an object Herder has no surface for: reported, never a failure. `expect` lists the leaves a surface cannot work without, so reading one leaf of an object does not pass the whole of it. A leaf no entry matches belongs to an object this file does not know, which is a finding until it is wired or waived. Order matters: first match wins. `informed: true` marks an object the CPE sends on every Inform, where a stored value counts as read.
